I lost the original Whirlpool retaining screws when I moved the dishwasher, so I checked Amazon for a replacement. These little plastic pieces were expensive so I bought the knockoff. Big mistake. These were even more flimsy than the originals and the screws disintegrated upon installation. The screws are so small they pulled right thru the square hole. So I found a couple bigger screws with bigger heads than the square hole, sprayed them black, and screwed them into the retainer pieces. It did the job, but it was an expensive price for half a purchase. Moral of the story: buy the real version for a couple bucks more.
